summary: Hail has lab-tested curves (PV modules only); flood and hurricane wind have curves built from transferred and our judgment evidence (flood: 6 parts and hurricane wind: 8 parts); convective wind has curves that are our judgment (4 parts); wildfire has curves built from lab-tested, transferred and our judgment evidence (9 parts). 1 part of the solar farm has no curve under any hazard: replacement support and fieldwork.
summary_v0: Hail, flood, hurricane wind, convective wind and wildfire have curves for solar farms, with evidence from T2–T4; nobody has yet searched for field reports.

hazards.label: Heat
hazards.effect_note: The twin's heat leads (ageing, derating, chiller capacity) work through performance, not physical damage; pointer to the outage-as-performance work, no curve (discussion 04 §6).

hazards.label: Icing
hazards.effect_note: Two leads in the twin: snow load on the venting panels (physical, L) and cold limiting the charge rate until heated (performance, L). No hazard cell; the C-172 snow-and-ice reasoning applies (discussion 04 §6).

hazards.label: Lightning
hazards.effect_note: No hazard cell exists; the twin carries Medium surge leads on the electronics (discussion 04 §6).

split.sentence: These cells split the solar farm differently: the cells name different numbers of parts: flood 8, hail 1, convective wind 5, hurricane wind 11 and wildfire 10; mounting: trackers and racking is a unit under convective wind, hurricane wind and wildfire; flood and hail list it as no curve yet; foundations is a unit under flood, convective wind, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet; inverters and combiners is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet; convective wind does not mention it; collection cable is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail and convective wind do not mention it; transformers, switchgear and the GSU substation is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet; convective wind does not mention it; and more below. No reference plant budget exists for solar farms in this repository (Hazard has one for batteries and substations); each cell states its own shares, on its own basis.
details: the cells name different numbers of parts: flood 8, hail 1, convective wind 5, hurricane wind 11 and wildfire 10
mounting: trackers and racking is a unit under convective wind, hurricane wind and wildfire; flood and hail list it as no curve yet
foundations is a unit under flood, convective wind, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet
inverters and combiners is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet; convective wind does not mention it
collection cable is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail and convective wind do not mention it
transformers, switchgear and the GSU substation is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet; convective wind does not mention it
SCADA and communications is a unit under flood, convective wind, hurricane wind and wildfire; hail lists it as no curve yet
grounding and lightning protection is a unit under wildfire; flood lists it as no curve yet; hail, convective wind and hurricane wind do not mention it
civil works: roads, fencing, buildings is a unit under hurricane wind and wildfire; flood and hail list it as no curve yet; convective wind does not mention it
replacement support and fieldwork is a unit under hurricane wind; wildfire lists it as no curve yet; flood, hail and convective wind do not mention it
hurricane wind treats power conversion and collection as one unit that spans inverters and combiners and collection cable
PV modules: flood gives it 33 %, hail gives it 33 %, convective wind gives it 40 %, hurricane wind gives it 66 % and wildfire gives it 33 % of the plant's value
mounting: trackers and racking: convective wind gives it 14 %, hurricane wind gives it 25 % and wildfire gives it 13 % of the plant's value
foundations: flood gives it 4 %, convective wind gives it 8 %, hurricane wind gives it 4 % and wildfire gives it 4 % of the plant's value
inverters and combiners: flood gives it 4 %, hurricane wind gives it 13 % and wildfire gives it 4 % of the plant's value
collection cable: flood gives it 8 %, hurricane wind gives it 13 % and wildfire gives it 8 % of the plant's value

the shares are not on one basis: share of the physical replaceable base (artifact default); share of the physical replaceable base (direct module hardware profile); share of the physical replaceable base (workbook Value_Link sheet); share of the physical replacement value, 2024 USD per kWdc (named reference profile)
